sources.name: IGN
sources.title: The Witcher 4 Will Have a Comparable Leap From GTA 5 to GTA 6, Says CD Projekt Red
sources.text: CD Projekt Red expects a leap between The Witcher 3 and 4 that is comparable to the one between GTA 5 and 6. In a recent earnings call (via Eurogamer ), CDPR was peppered with questions about GTA 6, since the developer also makes ambitious open-world games. CDPR joint-CEO Michał Nowakowski was asked whether or not the studio is looking at GTA for inspiration and if people can expect a similar leap between games. He noted that they have, indeed, observed the jump between GTA 5 and 6 before stating that fans can expect something comparable for The Witcher 4. "We believe there's going to be a comparable leap between The Witcher 3 and The Witcher 4 — I think so, yes," he said. "It's been 11 years, we are working on The Witcher 4 to make it significantly better looking and improved in terms of pretty much every possible facet of the game, so yes, you should expect us to make a much bigger jump between Witcher 3 and Witcher 4." The leap between GTA 5 and 6 is pretty absurd. There's a significant number of more things to do, particularly for those interested in roleplaying as a criminal. You can steal drugs, rob banks, knock over virtually any store on the map, and so much more. A lot of these details were either reserved for scripted missions in GTA 5 or were underbaked as open-world activities, but are fully fleshed out for you to do however you want in GTA 6. Advancements in NPCs, interactivity, immersion, and the ability to enter hundreds of interiors also make GTA 6 feel a world apart from its predecessor. Will The Witcher 4 also have tons of enterable interiors or deeper interactions with random NPCs? It's too soon to tell. It's possible that the leap for CD Projekt Red could come in a number of other ways, as The Witcher is a totally different world from GTA, after all. Maybe monster hunting will be more nuanced and involved than in The Witcher 3, similar to how GTA 6 has more engaging criminal activities. CDPR also noted that it plans to find ways to expand the game to more mainstream audiences, like GTA 6 has. GTA 6 collaborated with major mainstream artists to create original music, in addition to bold marketing campaigns that made the game difficult to ignore. The Witcher 4 is currently targeting a 2028 release , and we can probably expect more looks at the game next year. CDPR also noted that it has signed a marketing agreement with PlayStation for the game, which will also cover previous games and allow for opportunities with PlayStation Plus' services. Cade Onder is a freelancer for IGN's news team. He covers all things entertainment, including gaming, film, and more. You can find him on Twitter @Cade_Onder.

sources.title: The difference between The Witcher 3 and Witcher 4 will be 'comparable' to that of GTA 5 and GTA 6, CD Projekt boss says: 'I mean, it's been 11 years'
sources.text: CD Projekt Red reported its Q3 earnings today, but all anyone wanted to talk about was GTA 6. CD Projekt made its Q3 2026 financial report today, and there's not a whole lot to see: The Witcher 3 remaster was a big hit, work on Cyberpunk 2 and The Witcher 4 is ticking along, and everyone really liked Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2. Perhaps understandably, a number of questions in the subsequent investors call put the focus on Grand Theft Auto 6 . While CD Projekt joint CEO Michał Nowakowski didn't go too deep on the topic, he did say that the upcoming Witcher 4 will be comparable to GTA 6 in at least one way. "Obviously, this is a call about us, not about Rockstar, but I do understand the connection here," Nowakowski said when asked if The Witcher 4 will represent a technological leap over its predecessor comparable to GTA 6. "Having said that, of course, I'm not going to make a deep dive and a full-blown review of GTA 5 versus GTA 6. But of course, we did look at the game. We did see the differences. "Do we believe there's going to be a comparable leap between Witcher 3 and Witcher 4? I think so, yes. I mean, it's been 11 years. We are working on The Witcher 4 to make it significantly better looking and improved in terms of pretty much every possible facet of the game. So yes, you should expect us to make a much bigger jump between Witcher 3 and Witcher 4." Well, sure. As Nowakowski said, The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt was released 11 years ago, and it'll be two more years before The Witcher 4 comes out—assuming it's not delayed, which would make it a rarity among CD Projekt games. It will also be the same number of years between Witcher 3 and 4 as spanned GTA 5 and 6. In the world of technology, 13 years is a long time. Hell, just the upgrade from the original Witcher 3 to the remastered version that dropped earlier this year is notable: At the same time, Nowakowski said that while the GTA 6 launch was tremendously successful, CD Projekt Red doesn't intend to merely mimic Rockstar's approach when The Witcher 4 is ready to go: "Our games are different and the require a certain different approach, and we just do certain things differently than they do." Keep up to date with the most important stories and the best deals, as picked by the PC Gamer team. He also said that while the release of GTA 6 has had an impact on Witcher 3 and Cyberpunk 2077 sales on consoles, he doesn't expect it to have a "material impact" on the company's Q4 finances for one obvious reason. "You do have to remember that a lot of our players are also PC-based," Nowakowski said. "GTA has not launched on PC. We have not seen any impact whatsoever on the PC sales on engagement." And, he added, "on the PS5 and Xbox, it's not like our sales came to zero." Nowakowsi also said that GTA 6 hasn't changed CD Projekt's ambitions for The Witcher 4 and Cyberpunk 2: If anything, it's "an inspiration in many ways for our developers." And he's not concerned about its success pushing up development budgets, because CD Projekt's games "are not budget-driven developments." "I'm not saying that we don't care about the budgets. We do, and I'm pretty sure [Rockstar] did as well," Nowakowski said. "But you cannot make games like that having in mind, 'This is the fixed number of money I want to spend, and that's it. Otherwise, we're gone.' "They are ambition-driven developments and money is important. The budgets are not indefinite. That's not what we're saying. But the philosophy is kind of like I said. And honestly, that philosophy has not changed for us because of GTA 6's release. It has just always been like that." Nowakowski's positive take on GTA 6 isn't too far off that of Cyberpunk 2 creative director Igor Sarzynski, who said yesterday that he's suffering from " GTA 6-induced-open-world-game-dev-depression ," although he quickly clarified that CD Projekt is "doing something of our own, with a different unique flavor." (And that he wasn't being serious about cancelling Cyberpunk 2.) seriously though i think we're doing something of our own, with a different unique flavor. GTA is impressive in a way all great art is, it expands what is possible, a captivating vision flawlessly executed The Witcher 4 is currently slated for launch sometime in 2028, while Cyberpunk 2 isn't expected out before 2030. sources.title: Cyberpunk 2 Development Ramps Up At CD Projekt Red, But Ambitions For The Project Are ‘Not Changed’ By GTA 6′s Success
sources.text: CD Projekt Red Cyberpunk 2077 Grand Theft Auto VI GTA 6 The Witcher 4 While the eyes of the world are focused on Grand Theft Auto VI , the rest of games industry must continue on in its wake. Yesterday, CD Projekt Red held its latest financial briefing, updating investors on the progress of upcoming titles and its long-running hits, including news that Cyberpunk 2 ‘s development team has grown to nearly 200. And given the overlap between CDPR’s games with their elaborate open worlds and those of GTA 6 , investors wanted to know how the latter’sÂ phenomenal success will impact the studio’s work. Polish studio CD Projekt Red is known for its work on open-world adventures like The Witcher and Cyberpunk , and during the briefing investorsÂ asked whether the success of GTA will impact the design process and development of those series. CDPR explained that as much as the game is an “inspiration” to them, there is no need to adjust the road-map in response to the success of Rockstarâs work. “We have certain ambitions when it comes to The Witcher and Cyberpunk 2 , but they have not changed when it comes to GTA 6 ,” was the response given to an investor. “It’s always great to see games like that because they show you how much cool stuff can be done. That’s for sure an inspiration in many ways for our developers.â That being said, if there were to be a comparison between the works of the two studios, CD Projekt Red believes that the long development time between The Witcher 3 and 4 has led to a comparable leap in fidelity to that seen between GTA 5 and 6 . Excluding the recent release of The Witcher 3 Remastered on modern consoles in September, the CDPR’s last major video game release was 2020’s Cyberpunk 2077 . Yet despite this, revenue for the company has only grown, and anticipation for its work remains high. The release of The Witcher 3 Remastered saw the game record its highest concurrent player count in its history, with 138,000 players at once, despite the core game being over a decade old. This is something the company credits to its work bringing in new players via broad multimedia expansion. The Witcher has received numerous TV series with Netflix, while the Cyberpunk Edgerunners anime with Studio Trigger recently premiered its second season. CDPR noted that the show reached the top 10 in 55 countries on its release and debuted third on the streaming serviceâs global top 10. More importantly for the studio, it brought people back to playing Cyberpunk 2077 , coinciding with a new update tied to the anime’s story. CDPR stated that âthe anime brings people to the franchise, and the update gives them a reason to play.â The anime boosted the gameâs concurrent player count across all platforms to over 2.1 million players, triple where it was before the anime’s second season premiered. Roughly half of the studio (513 out of 1051 developers) is now working on The Witcher 4 ahead of a planned 2028 release, with 199 developers working on Cyberpunk 2 , a slight increase from earlier this year. This has led to the team working on the Witcher spin-off, currently titles Sirius , shrinking slightly from 84 developers to a team of 60, while a new IP known as Hades remains in development with a smaller team. sources.title: CD Projekt Red signs new marketing partnership deal with Sony for The Witcher 4, and to increase "the presence" of its games on PlayStation
sources.text: As part of The Witcher and Cyberpunk studio CD Projekt Red's recent Q3 earnings report, the developer offered some updates on upcoming game The Witcher 4 . During an earnings call yesterday, the studio revealed it had signed a new partnership deal with Sony regarding marketing rights to The Witcher 4, as well as to extend "the presence" of CD Projekt Red's other games across the PlayStation Store and PlayStation Plus. "Just today, we signed new partnership agreements with Sony Interactive Entertainment covering the presence of our games on PlayStation and in PlayStation Plus subscriptions, as well as our collaboration during the upcoming Witcher 4 marketing campaign," said studio CFO Piotr Nielubowicz . "This cooperation will support our business and financial outlook in this and future years." Nielubowicz didn't elaborate on what exactly that means for The Witcher 4's marketing, but perhaps it could enable Sony to advertise the action-RPG as a PlayStation game, similar to the Grand Theft Auto 6 'plays best on PlayStation' campaign . But seeing as The Witcher 4 is currently targeting a 2028 release , we may not find out what form that agreement takes for some time. That said, looking at similar marketing agreements from Sony's recent history, we can probably expect The Witcher 4 to show up during Sony State of Play presentations or even have dedicated PlayStation-focused showcases. The Witcher 4 footage may also be specified as being captured on PlayStation hardware - something we already saw with The Witcher 4 tech demo last year . Perhaps we'll see Witcher-themed accessories and PlayStation hardware, too. This is a notable shift for CDPR, which has historically had close ties to Xbox. Cyberpunk 2077's big Keanu Reeves reveal (as Johnny Silverhand) took place on Xbox's E3 2019 stage , and The Witcher 3 's reveal happened on Microsoft's E3 2013 stage. Going further back, Xbox 360 was the only console The Witcher 2 was released on. During the same earnings call, CDPR joint-CEO Michał Nowakowski said that we should expect the leap between The Witcher 3 and The Witcher 4 to be similar to that between GTA 5 and GTA 6 , while also praising Rockstar's approach to marketing its record-breaking new game.

sources.title: How to Play Grand Theft Auto VI in the Cloud and with Remote Play
sources.text: Grand Theft Auto VI supports XBOX Cloud Gaming , making it available to play even without a current-gen console. With XBOX Cloud Gaming, you can play by streaming it straight from the cloud to your XBOX One, or XBOX Series X|S if you’d like to save some hard drive space. Select Game Pass plans include a monthly allotment of up to 15 play hours, and you can buy more cloud playtime if you need it, giving you the opportunity to experience one of the biggest games of the year on the consoles you already own. The game uses XBOX Series S graphics settings when cloud-streamed with XBOX Cloud Gaming. You can also access Remote Play to enjoy Grand Theft Auto VI wherever you want to play , allowing you to stream gameplay directly from your XBOX Series X|S console to devices you already own, like your mobile phone, laptops, PCs, or even a handheld gaming PC like the XBOX ROG Ally. Here’s how to get these features up and running (a copy of Grand Theft Auto VI from the XBOX Store is required): To start your Cloud gaming session in Grand Theft Auto VI , you can use the controllers that are connected to your console following these steps: When possible, connecting a wired Ethernet cable is the best option for gaming quality. FYI, even wireless networks with high bandwidth can occasionally have a dip in audio and video quality. Remote Play allows you to stream gameplay from your XBOX Series X|S to devices you already own, like mobile devices, PCs, and handheld gaming PCs. Here’s how to enable it: Once you’ve completed those steps above, you can move forward with Remote Play on one of your devices: Whether you’re streaming from the Cloud to save space or picking up right where you left off on your handheld PC, XBOX Cloud Gaming and Remote Play give you more ways to play Grand Theft Auto VI on the devices you already own. For more info, visit XBOX Cloud Gaming and Grand Theft Auto VI on the XBOX Store.

sources.title: Agradecemos por tornarem Grand Theft Auto VI o maior lançamento da história PlayStation
sources.text: Uma homenagem à comunidade PlayStation e à Rockstar Games por proporcionarem um momento incrível para o universo dos games e do entretenimento. Após uma longa espera, os jogadores finalmente tiveram a chance de mergulhar em Grand Theft Auto VI . Foi incrível ver a comunidade PlayStation ao redor do mundo começar suas aventuras no estado de Leonida. Quer você tenha contado os dias para retornar às ruas de Vice City, ou esteja vivenciando a série Grand Theft Auto pela primeira vez, queremos aproveitar este momento para agradecer. A empolgação e a paixão da comunidade tornaram este um momento verdadeiramente especial para todos nós. O lançamento de GTAVI marca um momento extraordinário para os jogos e o entretenimento, tornando-se o maior lançamento de um jogo na história de PlayStation, ao longo de três décadas e cinco gerações de consoles. Mais de 39 milhões de jogadores únicos vivenciaram a história de Jason e Lucia em Grand Theft Auto VI para PlayStation 5. A comunidade PlayStation se uniu de forma expressiva para vivenciar Grand Theft Auto VI durante seu lançamento e fim de semana de estreia. Confira alguns destaques do período de lançamento, encerrado em 22 de novembro de 2026*: Estas são apenas algumas das maneiras pelas quais vimos nossa comunidade PlayStation se unir em torno deste momento incrível no mundo dos jogos, e estamos empolgados para ver como vocês continuarão criando e compartilhando novas memórias e experiências nos próximos meses. Por fim, gostaríamos de parabenizar nossos parceiros da Rockstar Games por trazerem este jogo extraordinário a jogadores de todo o mundo e por darem continuidade a uma parceria com a PlayStation que vem desde o Grand Theft Auto III, para PlayStation 2. Com GTAVI, trabalhamos para oferecer a melhor experiência no console PS5 e proporcionamos aos jogadores uma forma memorável de celebrar o título, por meio de dois controles sem fio DualSense de edição limitada, inspirados em Vice City. Também celebramos o lançamento com eventos ao vivo, incluindo o “Grand Theft Auto VI: The Festival”, realizado em Miami no último fim de semana. E à nossa comunidade PlayStation, obrigado pela paixão e pelo apoio contínuos, e por escolherem vivenciar GTAVI no console PS5 . É o entusiasmo de vocês que torna momentos como este tão significativos para todos nós. Mal podemos esperar para ver aonde suas aventuras em Leonida levarão vocês! *Todos os números baseiam-se em dados internos da SIE coletados de 19 de novembro de 2026 a 22 de novembro de 2026.

sources.title: GTA 6: How to flip a car in Grand Theft Auto 6
sources.text: How to flip a car in the open world and reset your car in races in Grand Theft Auto 6 It happens to the best of us. You were driving down the road in Grand Theft Auto 6, and what shouldâve been a tiny tap turned into you flipping your car. At least youâre still alive, right? Back in the PS2 days, simply turning the wheel to the side would have your car correct itself and flip back onto all four wheels, but itâs not so easy in GTA 6 thanks to that pesky ârealism.â In this guide, weâre breaking down how to flip cars back over in Grand Theft Auto 6 â this can also be used to push boats into the water and more. Guides: If you're playing Grand Theft Auto 6, make sure to checkÂ out ourÂ complete walkthrough hub , featuringÂ beginner tips , navigation experience explained , GTA 6 cheats , and more. Right, so hereâs the scenario: you were speeding down the highway, and you clipped another vehicle, sending you spinning out and rolling down the road sideways. Youâre alive, but you want to get back in your car and go, only itâs upside down. These things happen, and luckily, the developers give you a way to right your car. As Jason or Lucia, all you need to do is walk into the side of the car until your character changes to a pushing animation. Once in this animation, you can press X ( Xbox ) or Square ( PS5 ) to perform a Shove animation. Both Jason and Lucia are surprisingly strong, and a Shove should push your car over and onto its wheels, as long as you are pushing from the side. You can also use the same technique to push a beached boat back into the water. If youâre in a race, you canât leave your vehicle. Bad crashes happen in races especially, and the somewhat awkward physics of the game can make that happen more often than you might deserve. Hopefully a patch smooths that out in the future. In the meantime, if you have a bad crash in a race where your car gets flipped, or you crash and get entirely turned around, you can hold the Back button (Xbox) or the Touch Pad button (PS5) to “Reset” your car onto the road, facing the correct direction. These crashes have the potential to ruin your race, though. If that happens, you might want to go to the pause menu and select the Restart Event option.

sources.title: God of War Laufey's Faye actor jumps from games to live-action, as Amazon casts Deborah Ann Woll in upcoming series
sources.text: After appearing in both God of War Ragnarok and next year's God of War Laufey, Deborah Ann Woll is about to reprise her role as Faye in Amazon Prime Video's upcoming live-action series. Variety reports that the God of War cast list is now welcoming a second actor pulled straight from Sony Santa Monica's video game series. Deborah Ann Woll first showed up in the games as Kratos' wife and Atreus' mother during God of War Ragnarok, but she's also about to enter the spotlight proper in God of War Laufey. Amazon's God of War cast now includes Dave Bautista (Guardians of the Galaxy) as god killer Kratos, Callum Vinson (Chucky) as Atreus, Mandy Patinkin as Odin and Ólafur Darri Ólafsson as Thor. Alastair Duncan is also making the game-to-show jump by stepping back into the figurative shoes of chatty head Mimir. Earlier in the year, the God of War show halted production when former Kratos actor Ryan Hurst suffered an on-set injury. Bautista soon took over the role and production began again in October - all of Hurst's scenes had to be reshot, of course. There's no release date yet for the show, but it's said to follow the Norse era of the games which began in 2018's more serious and stern revamp. Amazon ordered a two-season run for the show, which apparently means both seasons will be filmed back-to-back. Meanwhile, God of War Laufey was recently delayed from February 2027 to May 2027, giving the PS5 exclusive slightly more breathing room away from Fable, Persona 4 Revival and Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis. "We will make the most of each moment until then by putting in the finishing touches and pushing the game to its fullest potential," developer Sony Santa Monica said at the time. "On behalf of everyone on the team, we appreciate your patience and we'll be back to share more updates soon." While the game puts Faye in the leading role as she battles with gods in a multi-mythological afterlife, the studio was quick to note that her journey isn't considered a side game. God of War Laufey will still connect to future games in the series and, yep, Kratos will eventually be back , too. "Genuinely, I thought I was going to be much more offended by it, but one, I'm not on social media, so that helps, and two, I don't know, I feel totally unbothered," Woll said of the online trolls who were targeting Laufey after its reveal this summer. "Because I just know it's great. It's okay if it's not your cup of tea, but in no universe is it bad."

sources.title: Lords of the Fallen 2 delayed to April 2027, release date coming next month
sources.text: The sequel was only announced last summer It's happening. We have some more movement on Lords of the Fallen 2 from CI Games. No, there still isn't a release date, but we know when we're getting one. The action RPG sequel is now due to arrive slightly later than previously announced, but still in the first half of 2027, and we'll be hearing more quite soon. Marek Tyminski, the CEO of CI Games, reveals the details himself. "Lords of the Fallen 2: April 2027," he writes on Twitter . "Exact date in December." What Tyminski's post doesn't specify this that this is actually another delay. The game was originally due in the back half of this year, before moving to the first quarter of 2027 . While it's slightly annoying to only get an announcement for the announcement, at least we know we don't have long to wait to find out when exactly Lords of the Fallen 2 is coming out. Knowing the release month is very helpful too. I could be wrong here, of course, but that seems to all but guarantee the game's presence at The Game Awards. Trailers and reveals are always a big part of the show, and I'm not sure where else we might see the follow-up otherwise, unless CI Games is planning some sort of livestream of its own we're not yet aware of. Regardless of the delay, this is all pretty quick turnaround for the release, since Lords of the Fallen 2 was only announced during the Opening Night Live of Gamescom 2025. Maybe I'm just jaded from increasingly elongated announcement schedules for blockbuster games, but getting the release window only a year and a half after the formal reveal is pretty tight by today's standards. I mean, we just waited years to find out what the full title of The Elder Scrolls 6 is. We'll see what CI Games has to offer come December, which, at time of writing, is just six days away. Maybe Mariah Carey will be involved in some way. I doubt it, but imagine. I bet she loves a bit of Lords of the Fallen, honestly. "Blizzard, I'm looking at you" - Path of Exile 2 boss calls out AAA studios' lackluster game announcements, implores devs to stop trying to have a "'one more thing' moment." sources.title: How to steal the Schafter V12 in GTA 6
sources.text: Prove yourself to Raul by yoinking this car. Stealing the Schafter V12 in GTA 6 is one of the car theft missions you'll have to complete to gain Raul's trust, but similar to the BF Bandito or Declasse Vamos , it's a little tricky. Make sure to grab the silenced pistol from the trunk of the car outside—not necessarily because you'll need it, but because it's a handy weapon to have. Now, as you can see in the video above, you can get into the chop shop by climbing up the van around back and then onto the roof. I'd then suggest dropping down on the right side, where there are few enemies, knocking out the guy sitting by the gate, then opening it by hitting the left button. Sneak back towards the centre of the chop shop and turn left to find the Declasse Vamos, a black unassuming car. Hop inside, start it up, and drive out of the gate you just opened. Easy, right? Now simply bring it to Randy's garage as directed. You also kill everyone inside if you wish, but my way above will get you that non-lethal Criminal Profile rating. sources.title: How to steal the GTA 6 Schafter v12
sources.text: The GTA 6 Schafter v12 is not what you might think, which is what makes this theft tricky at first If you're having trouble heisting the GTA 6 Schafter v12 for Raul, it's easier than you might think. The problem is that you've gotten used to stealing cars for Moses in GTA 6 Chapter 1, but now you're working for Raul, and his jobs are a little more... unusual. So, if you're driving away from the scene of the crime in a hot new motor, police on your tail, wondering why you're being told your job's not done, here's where you might be going wrong when trying to steal the Schafter v12 in GTA 6. If you're struggling with this mission, the problem is most likely that you're stealing the wrong car. You should be looking for the shabby green car parked under the canopy with its trunk roof missing. Having been keeping an eye out for so many nice cars by this point, be it for yourself, for Moses, or for Raul, you're lulled into a false sense of security. You go into this mission all guns blazing, literally, thinking you know what's up and that you don't need to waste time Wainking it. That stunning muscle car with the growling exposed engine and massive exhausts must be the car you're after, right? Wrong. Clearly placed here to lead you astray on purpose, that's actually the strangely reasonably priced Imponte Bloodbath Phoenix, so I recommend heading back to the area and taking that one for yourself later. For the Car Service mission, however, you'll need to drive away in the crumbling Benefactor Shafter v12. Other than that, the only trouble you'll meet with this mission is the same as ever: a few criminals with weapons ready to be drawn. The best way to complete this one is to head onto the roof from round the back of the gated area before taking them all out with a silenced handgun, which I recommend for most small-to-medium heists at this stage. If you're looking for more cars to steal for yourself, make sure you pick up the Paul Walker GTA 6 car , inspired by the 1995 Fast and Furious Mitsubishi Eclipse. And don't skip over the pink Porsche in GTA 6 , which you can only get if you pay attention in Chapter 2. © GamesRadar+. Not to be reproduced without permission. sources.title: GTA 6 Safe Word Mission Walkthrough: How to Steal the Practice Safe
sources.text: Things get explicit in Safe Word in GTA 6 Safe Word is a main story mission in GTA 6 that sees Jason and Lucia steal a practice safe from a mansion in Peacock Estates. Given by Nicole Park, the mission is part of the preparations for the upcoming bank heist and introduces players to the game’s safecracking mechanics. This is one of dozens of GTA 6 guides we’ve published this week. Check out our GTA 6 Guide Hub . Guides: If you're playing Grand Theft Auto 6, make sure to checkÂ out ourÂ complete walkthrough hub , featuringÂ beginner tips , navigation experience explained , GTA 6 cheats , and more. To unlock Safe Word, you must first complete the Company Property mission. Once finished, return to Raul’s compound in Stockyard and speak to Nicole. Take the large truck outside and drive towards Gil’s mansion in Peacock Estates, located in the southern part of Vice City. The estate is in an afluent area with a security guard at the entrance. Slow down as you approach the barrier to the island, as smashing through it could cause the police to be alerted, interuppting the mission. Once you arrive, you’ll take control of Jason. Crouch through the front gate and move around the right-hand side of the mansion. When an assistant approaches, follow her towards the backyard and the film set. You’ll need to play along with the production. Follow the on-screen instructions to skim the pool, look at Samantha and apply lotion to Sasha. Next, you’ll have to fake a fight with the other actor. You need to fight Rodney by punching him, allowing him to hit you before knocking him out. You don’t need to worry about really hurting him here, as this is part of a scripted sequence. When asked whether you want to participate further, choose not to if you want to avoid upsetting Lucia. That’s what I did at least. If you choose to participate, your relationship meter will be effected. For more on what happens with each option in Safe Word, check out our guide.Â Once the scene ends enter the mansion from the side you were originally stopped at and locate Gil’s office. Search the left-hand drawer of his desk to find the remote that reveals the safe. The safe is behind the large image of the behind. Open the window and attach the truck’s winch to the safe. Switch to Lucia and pull it out. Jason will jump out of the now-gaping window hole and join Lucia. Drive to the garage with the safe attached. Swing it into pursuing vehicles, but avoid cyclists and cemetery gravestones. If you hit the gravestones, your criminal profile will take a hit. Finally, return to Raul’s compound and complete the three safecracking practice stages: drilling, guiding the camera cable and opening the safe. This minigame is essential to pracitce, as it will be a central tenant of The Cartel Heist. Completing the safecracking practice unlocks Gil’s Kalinga .50 pistol variant and rewards you with $1,500. Safe Word also teaches the mechanics needed for the upcoming bank heist, making it an important GTA 6 story mission.

sources.title: GTA 6 leaker reportedly releases file needed to run leaked Xbox build
sources.text: Some are predicting it could lead to a PC version within days GTA 6 leaker Cyberleek has reportedly released the executable file for the leaked Xbox build of the game, prompting concern that an unofficial PC port could follow. The leak comes via the same group that shared leaked footage and threatened to release additional videos unless Rockstar changed its all-digital launch strategy a week before Rockstar released its extended gameplay teaser on Netflix . The group then threatened to release a full build of the game, including its full story mode and end credits. Now, as reported by IGN , Cyberleek has released the .exe for the incomplete Xbox build, with some predicting that AI-assisted recompilation of the build could get GTA 6 running on PC within days. The file was released alongside a new statement in which Cyberleek claimed their actions were about "fighting anti-consumerism in the games industry." They also referenced Take-Two's efforts to stop the leaks and identify whoever is behind them, saying: "Months of takedowns, subpoenas and wallet tracing later, the hunt is still on and the uploads keep arriving." Cyberleek also pushed back on claims that the leaks are little more than a crypto scheme, insisting the crypto was used to raise money for a secret project unrelated to the game. "There is no other way to move funds without names," they said, "and this work requires no names." According to IGN, the leaked Xbox build runs counter to the idea that Cyberleek only had access to an early build. Take-Two previously issued subpoenas to companies including Discord as part of its search for those responsible for the leaks. It remains unclear how this build got out of Rockstar.

sources.name: PC Gamer
sources.title: Cyberleek releases executable for GTA 6 Xbox build leaked last week: 'The torch passes to the open source recomp and emulation projects'
sources.text: The notorious GTA 6 leaker called it "an early Christmas gift." Grand Theft Auto 6 leaker Cyberleek appears to have followed through on their threat to release the executable of the Xbox build of GTA 6 they put into the wild last week, calling it "an early Christmas gift" for followers and explicitly linking the leak to efforts to recreate the game on PC: "The torch passes to the open source recomp and emulation projects." Cyberleek released a near-complete build of GTA 6 late last week, holding back only the main exe—the part that makes everything else run, basically—until either their crypto coin achieved a $15 million market cap, or November 23, whichever came first. The crypto missed badly, but time marches on, and so here we are. The release of the exe, naturally, includes a call for more "donations" in its readme file (via Reddit ) which Cyberleek said will go toward a secretive project "for the gamers." They also taunted Take-Two Interactive's efforts to track them down : "Months of takedowns, subpoenas and wallet tracing later, the hunt is still on and the uploads keep arriving. No budget makes a lock unbreakable, and no court order deletes what the internet already has." Leaks in the game industry aren't anything new, but this case is unique: GTA 6, effectively the biggest videogame of all time, still hasn't been announced for PC, as is Take-Two's way . But the advent of AI means the game could be emulated on our platform far more quickly than was possible in the past—some modders estimated it could happen within a week. One of the leads on the Leonida recomp project predicted that things will start to move quickly from here: At the same time, Shayder tempered expectations in a message on the Leonida Discord, saying "it will take at least a week" for the project to reach the point where GTA will be playable on PC. How that unofficial emulated made-with-AI build would compare to the real deal is an open question, and I strongly suspect the answer will be "not well," but even just having something GTA 6-ish playable on PC is a headache that I'm pretty sure Take-Two would rather not have to deal with. I also wonder whether it will prompt Take-Two to release GTA 6 on PC more quickly than it has with previous releases. A rumor to that effect surfaced in October and I had serious doubts, but it's possible that ongoing emulation efforts will expedite its arrival.. I haven't verified whether the released exe is legit, but the previously-released material appears to be and the general consensus is that this is too. sources.name: PC Gamer
sources.title: Every GTA 6 ending and how to get them
sources.text: All the endings (and a couple variations) for GTA 6 we've seen so far. Obviously, massive spoilers follow for GTA 6 endings! There are multiple endings to GTA 6 , and while we haven't experienced them all personally here at PC Gamer, the gaming community has been sharing them around for anyone curious about what they may have missed. The ending you get depends on the choices you make during the final GTA 6 story mission , but also depends on how you handled Jason and Lucia's romance and criminal profiles throughout the game, so seeing every version of the ending would mean not just playing the ending multiple times, but having different playthroughs of the game altogether. There are a couple of endings that I don't consider "different" from each other but do have some differences leading up to them, which I'll explain below. There may also be additional endings we haven't seen yet, so we may update this guide in the future. In the bridge endings, Jason and Lucia have defeated Mendez and his squad and gotten the hard drive back from Georgio's penthouse and escaped. They drive to Cal's place in Key Lento, but discover he has been compromised. They drive to the bridge, but the cops have set up a roadblock and have the couple trapped. Lucia wants to keep going, but Jason suggests they jump off the bridge and swim for it. A choice comes up on the screen: "Swim For it" or "No Surrender." Jason and Lucia try to run the roadblock and are shot to death by cops on the bridge. They die holding hands. In the credits, we see that their son Tomas lives happily with Lucia's aunt, her husband, and their children. Jason and Lucia are shot to death by cops on the bridge. They die holding hands. In the credits, their lawyer, Abe, brings the money to Lucia's aunt. Tomas lives happily with Lucia's aunt, her husband, and their children in a much bigger house than the other No Surrender ending. Choosing "Swim for it" presents an additional choice. When Jason gets out of the car, Lucia can choose to "Exit" the car with him, or change her mind by not choosing it. Jason and Lucia decide to jump off the bridge and swim for it. They both exit the car without holding guns. Lucia jumps, but Jason doesn't jump and is arrested. Lucia signs a deal for immunity while Jason goes to prison. Lucia gets a job in a diner. Lucia takes Tomas to meet Jason in prison, but he can only see his son through a glass divider. Jason and Lucia decide to jump off the bridge and swim for it. Jason exits the car with a gun, but Lucia changes her mind and stays in the car. The police open fire and Jason and Lucia are both shot to death. Tomas lives with Lucia's aunt, her husband, and their children. Jason and Lucia decide to jump off the bridge and swim for it, Jason doesn't jump and is arrested. Two years later, Lucia uses the savings account to get Jason freed from prison. Lucia goes to the prison to pick up Jason. Jason meets Tomas and holds his hand. If you don't have a strong relationship between Jason and Lucia, there is a different ending location: the base of Georgio's tower. In these endings, the couple never makes it to the bridge. You can also choose to break up the couple, either as Jason or as Lucia, as you begin the mission Protective Custody. After the tower fight with Georgio's men, police confront the couple at the base of the tower. The police open fire and Jason pushes Lucia down. Jason is shot. Lucia has a choice to "Stay down" or "Defend Jason". She stays down and watches Jason die. Lucia is arrested, signs a deal, and visits Tomas at her aunt's house. Lucia then leaves Tomas with her aunt, takes out a gun, and continues her life of crime by preparing to rob a diner. After the tower fight with Georgio's men, police confront them at the base of the tower. The police open fire and Jason pushes Lucia down. Jason is shot. Lucia chooses "Defend Jason" and fights the cops. They die together. On the way down to ground level at the tower, Jason decides to run. Lucia is arrested and signs the deal, then lives with her aunt and Tomas while working in a diner. One night there's a knock on the door and she finds a bag of cash on the porch. We see Jason driving away with... Rocco the drug-sniffing dog from earlier in the game. Sure, that might as well happen. How to get this ending (sourced by GamingwithTZ on YouTube ): Jason and Lucia make a deal with Mendez after defeating him. Once they have the hard drive, they're surrounded by cops at the bottom of the tower. Mendez arrives and takes them away in his car, then drives them to the swamp. Later in the credits, we see two skulls in the swamp, side-by-side, with a bullet hole in each. Note : You may need a specific criminal profile for this ending. I tried to take the deal (as Lucia) in one of my ending playthroughs, but Jason shot Mendez anyway. I had both Jason and Lucia at "Professional" level criminal profiles. This ending was not available to me. Speculation, but this ending may only be available if you don't have "Professional" as your criminal profiles. There are potentially (and almost certainly) more endings to GTA 6. There are still a few combinations of all the different variables, including your romance level, criminal profile level, amount of money saved, and the choices you make during the final mission, that we haven't seen yet. We'll update this guide if the community finds more endings. sources.title: How to get Vanessa's Pink Porsche Growler in GTA 6
sources.text: Don't miss the GTA 6 Growler, a gorgeous pink Porsche - or Pfister, to use its legally-distinct name If you've seen rumblings of a super cute pink Porsche in GTA 6, then you've come to the right place. This is Vanessa's Growler (get your mind out the gutter), and it's totally free to steal and keep if you so want it. And if pink isn't your style, of course you can respray it, too, but I'd heavily recommend you keep it in its original state, as it was meant to be. Of course, this isn't actually a Porsche, it's a Pfister, but we all know this GTA 6 car manufacturer is the virtual world equivalent of the Porsche, and if you've always wanted one, then here's how to get your hands on the GTA 6 Growler. To get the GTA 6 Growler, you need to open a lock-up in La Perle using the door code 92665, which is obtained from the laptop in Vanessa's Vice City apartment. When you start Chapter 3, you move into Vanessa's apartment, but it turns out she left in a hurry (or did she?) and left all her stuff there, laptop included. Gain access to this laptop by working out the password, and you'll see a message telling Vanessa there's something for her in La Perle, next to Auntie's Place. This generous gift is the baby pink Pfister Growler, inspired by the Porsche Cayman, and it's free for the taking if you can find it. You'll even gain access to the garage by unlocking it, too, giving you somewhere to store your hot new wheels. Now you know where to find the pink Porsche and how to open the garage, I'll let you go about this mission on your own, but if you like some help, we've got separate guides to figuring out the GTA 6 laptop password and finding Auntie's Place in GTA 6 . © GamesRadar+. sources.title: How to steal the Ocelot Bloodless Jugular in GTA 6
sources.text: One of the cars Randy wants in GTA 6 is the Ocelot Bloodless Jugular—and don't let the name fool you, its a slick and speedy ride that'll you'll be tempted to keep for yourself. But Randy doesn't know the locations of many of the cars on his wishlist, and can't point you to the Ocelot Bloodless Jugular: you just need to keep an eye out for it. Luckily, we spotted it ourselves, so just follow the simple steps below to find it. Head to Belville : It's a town in Leonard County, in the central eastern part of the map, a bit south of Lake Leonida and north of La Perle. In the northern edge of Belville there's a little cluster of four homes laid out almost in an X pattern. The southernmost home of that cluster has a garage you can break into. Once you open the garage door, you'll see the white Ocelot Bloodless Jugular. You'll need the key cloner to get in, which I assume you already have since you're doing jobs for Randy. No need to worry about the tracker , it's a standard one so it won't transmit your location to the cops. You still don't want to dawdle, because the owner of the car has a gun and he's not afraid to use it. He'll start shooting if he sees you boost the car. Randy will pay you $10,615 for the Ocelot Bloodless Jugular. He'll pay an extra $5,000 if you bring it to him in pristine condition. sources.title: Here’s How To Get A Banshee In GTA 6 And Unlock A GTA 3-Inspired Trophy
sources.text: Obviously, you need to steal cars in Grand Theft Auto 6 ; itâs in the name of the game. But you might as well get something out of it beyond just new wheels and some money, so how about scoring a trophy along the way? The Bravado Banshee is a nice ride that you get a mission to steal in GTA 6âs third chapter, via a character named Randy. You could luck out and find a Banshee on the street, but if you want the Capital Offense trophy, you can kill two birds with one stone by hitting up the Sunrise Premium Autos showroom in Southside. Youâll find it between Vice City International Airport and Peacock Bay, next to an Illegals Good Store. Note that you canât do this before you do Randyâs mission âCloninâ Keys, Makinâ Gs.â Why? The Bravado Banshee, like a lot of expensive cars in the game, requires a key cloner , and Randy is the person who gives you one as part of that mission. After he’s added the app to your phone, you can head to Sunrise Premium Autos and walk back to the showroom where a shiny blue Bravado Banshee is just sitting there. Clone the key via the same method you would use to slim-jim a car door, and then step on in. The next part is how you get the Capital Offense trophy: Drive the car straight through the glass window and then gun it before the police get there. The trophy should pop immediately. The trophy itself is a reference to the easiest and most reliable way to get a Banshee in Grand Theft Auto 3 , where you would just visit a car showroom in the south part of the map, sit in a Banshee in the showroom, and then drive it through the glass window. The similarity to that setup here in GTA 6 seems to be a pretty direct reference to the now-25-year-old PS2 title.Â You can either give the Banshee to Randy for that mission or get it repainted and registered for yourself. And you can return later to this same spot and get another Banshee! Regardless of what you choose, youâre a bit richer and a bit further along in your progress toward a platinum trophy or a mythic achievement. Not bad for an afternoonâs work. sources.title: How to get the GTA 6 Ocelot Jugular
sources.text: Once Randy gets you to work, you need to hunt down specific cars, including the GTA 6 Ocelot Jugular Finding the Ocelot Jugular in GTA 6, like a bunch of other cars Randy wants from you, is no easy feat. Unlike your previous car heisting quests, you aren't given the location of the motors Randy's client is after, so you just have to keep your eye open when you're out and about, specifically in more affluent areas. All the cars on Randy's list, including the Ocelot Jugular, can be found in multiple GTA 6 locations, making this a little easier, so keep your eyes peeled outside Vice City nightclubs and casinos, for example. If you want things to be a little easier, though, I've got the location of a guaranteed spawn below. The Ocelot Jugular can be found around Vice City, particularly at lively hotspots after dark, but there's a guaranteed spawn in Belville, parked in a garage in a cul-de-sac as marked on the map above. Grabbing the Ocelot from this location at least means you can get another of Randy's cars checked off fast, without having to hunt around for days.
